actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (metabolic/proliferative RNA programs, PBRM1 enrichment, CDKN2A/chr9 loss) and no technical confounding, supporting retention as a discovery-stage candidate despite weak cross-modal cohesion.

C0002 shows a coherent PBRM1-mutant, BAP1-wildtype profile with distinctive CNV features and no technical confounding; structural coherence is modest but not incompatible, so it remains defensible for downstream validation.
C0003 is defined by strong BAP1 enrichment and interferon-response up-regulation with no technical confounding; cross-modal separation is weak but stability is higher, so retention is defensible.
C0004 has a striking coherent genotype (universal VHL mutation, complete PBRM1 absence) with no technical confounding; cross-modal coherence is WXS-driven but not contradicted, supporting retention.

C0005 shows strong VHL/PBRM1 depletion with coherent inflammatory/metabolic down-regulation and no technical confounding; WXS-driven coherence is not contradicted, so it remains a defensible discovery-stage candidate.
